newsitem.title: USA: Delta, China Southern in code-sharing deal.
newsitem.headline: Delta, China Southern in code-sharing deal.

text.p: Delta Air Lines Inc said on Wednesday it signed a preliminary agreement with China Southern Airlines that would lead to code-sharing flights to and from China.
Under the agreement, which is subject to government approval, Delta would purchase seats on China Southern's four-times-per-week Boeing 777-200 service between Los Angeles and Guangzhou.
China Southern would buy seats on Delta flights from Los Angeles to 13 destinations, including Atlanta, Boston, New York, Portland, Ore., and Washington, D.C.
